# include/blender/compat Documentation

*This file is automatically generated by merging README files from multiple branches.*

## From branch: codex/add-readme.md-for-compatibility-shims-2025-06-22


This folder holds minimal headers that let the SEP Blender module compile without
pulling in the full Blender SDK. Each header mirrors the memory layout of a few
Blender structures and declares the small set of functions that our code calls.
The definitions are intentionally lightweight so that the engine can build in
environments where Blender isn't present.

## Provided Shims

- **blender_types.h** – Simplified versions of `Object`, `Mesh` and related
  structs. It also defines small enums and function prototypes such as
  `BKE_mesh_from_object` and `DEG_id_tag_update` so we can link against Blender
  when available or stub them during tests.

## Folder Layout Discussion

The general shims used across modules live in `include/compat`. Those files
handle CUDA workarounds, GLM inclusion fixes and a minimal standard library
replacement. `include/blender/compat` is kept separate because the contents map
specifically to Blender's own headers. If the project grows more Blender specific
compatibility layers it might make sense to merge this directory under the main
`compat` folder, but for now the split keeps Blender-only code isolated from the
broader engine shims.
